note: City-owned Charles F. Moore Memorial municipal boat harbor at 902 S. Second St., on the St. Clair River at the mouth of the Pine River, an easy walk from downtown restaurants and shopping, with fire pits and a free shuttle within the city. Drive-in; small flat harbor sites fit a 23-ft RV. The harbor is staffed April 1 - October 15. Online booking at midnrreservations.com covers the harbor's boat slips only, not the campsites; call the harbor office (2026-10-22). --Claude
summary: City harbor site (live homepage) confirms 9 campsites with 50/30-amp electric and water plus a dump station. Its Rates, Amenities and Contact pages all return a WordPress 'critical error' (HTTP 500) today; the last archived rates page (Aug 2022) said $40/night RV, $45 premium weekends, $20 tents - too old to record, so fees stay empty. The harbor's season (April 1 - October 15) is stated for the dock staff, not the campground, so season was left as is. midnrreservations.com lists St. Clair Boat Harbor with 112 harbor slips and nothing else, so the campsites are not booked there. Showers left as is (the homepage is silent).
